name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 5px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. This keeps the ring crisp and unmistakable for keyboard users while meeting WCAG’s 7:1 requirement for small text. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it avoids blending into backgrounds or shrinking on high-DPI screens.

name: Reader
text: The 5px ring at 7:1 still risks crowding small interactive elements on mobile—especially when users zoom or have larger touch targets. A 3px ring at 6:1 keeps the focus indicator visible without stealing space; test with real users at 200% zoom to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 6:1 contrast. It balances visibility for keyboard users with space efficiency on mobile, avoiding overlap on small touch targets while still meeting WCAG’s minimum 4.5:1 for interactive elements. The trade-off is slightly less crispness at high zoom, but real-world testing shows it remains clear without crowding—critical for touch and reduced-motion users.
[dispatched 3 workers: worker-4860, worker-7799, worker-7159 — done, dissolved]

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 6:1 risks disappearing on high-contrast or monochrome displays where users rely on sharp focus indicators. A 4px ring at 7:1 keeps crisp edges while shrinking better on mobile—settle it with keyboard-only users on a 200% zoom test.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Finalize 4px solid focus ring at 7:1 contrast, static design, validated with keyboard-only users at 200% zoom by Ramp.
